#+TITLE: Daily Routine (fixture)
#+FILETAGS: :routine:

# The fixture's copy of ~/kb/notes/schedule.org's table, made
# machine-readable: the three columns org-routine needs (kind, days,
# bucket, habit) added to the prose table.  Regenerating the fixture
# (python3 testdata/generate.py) does not touch this file; it is the
# input the generator's (todo) routine.org agrees with.

* Variants

A variant replaces every routine row its time range overlaps, on the
days it applies.  Name the day in `org-routine-variant-days'.
